mapper.select: select asset.name as asset_name,asset.ip as asset_ip, cd.* from (select c.* from COLLECT_NETWORK_CARD c, ( select max(collect_code) as collect_code,asset_id from COLLECT_NETWORK_CARD group by asset_id) m where m.asset_id=c.asset_id and m.collect_code=c.collect_code) cd, (select a.* from asset a,sys_org s where a.ORG_ID=s.ID and s.TYPE=2 AND a.IS_DEL=1 AND a.DESK like '%183%') asset where asset.id=cd.asset_id
